method: Ghidra decompilation and instruction listings of the identified executable. Name literals, holder RTTI names, the _static%X literal, the property name literals and the 0x012C3F78 condition byte were compared with the PE bytes through its section table. Addresses are virtual addresses. Reach paths and call-site argument counts were measured from the Lua 5.1 bytecode of the shipped client scripts.
scope: Static Lua call contracts for the natives that the shipped DesktopWidget, MainMenuWidget, MapNavigationWidget, PlayerParameterWidget, StatusEffectWidget and WorldMaster _onInit paths reach after the boot contracts: declared argument and return StackOperator lists, owning native class, callback, forwarding target and yield behavior, plus the user config key domain and the object a LuaControl* return pushes. Natives already recorded in manifests/boot_native_call_contract.json or manifests/widget_native_call_contract.json are referenced, not repeated. Positions count post-receiver Lua arguments. Client-side contracts do not establish server behavior.

luaControlPush.behavior: Tag 6 pushes nil through 0x00CF33A0. Tag 4 with a null control also pushes nil. Any other tag raises bad_cast. A non-null control is resolved to its object reference through 0x00CD7A30, which returns the record at the control's +0x04, or the root record held at GameEngine +0x1BC when the control is the root control. 0x00CD7A50 then pushes the reference pool, the light userdata at record +0x08, indexes the Lua registry with it, pushes the key, the light userdata at record +0x04, and indexes that pool. When the result is not a table, it pops both values and indexes the registry pool named by the light userdata stored at 0x0130D4F8 with the root record key. The pool is removed and one value remains.
luaControlPush.consequence: The push returns the control's instance table when its pool holds one, otherwise the root record's entry in the pool named by the value at 0x0130D4F8. That fallback result is not type-checked. The push creates no Lua object.

framework.inlBinding: Each row's _u script declares a descriptor named <luaName>_inl that returns two strings, a receiver selector and <luaName>_cpp. Every row and deferred row here uses selector self.

reach.method: Static walk of the shipped script bytecode with the callOrder method of manifests/boot_native_call_contract.json. Receivers loaded from the desktopWidget and worldMaster globals resolve through DesktopWidget and WorldMaster, and every other receiver resolves through the walking class. Method definitions whose key is loaded into a register before the table store are included, which covers the DesktopWidget methods defined in widget/desktopwidget_connector. The leading unconditional jump in WidgetBaseClass._onInit skips a compiled-out _setLoopInterval call, which is not counted. DesktopWidget lookups fall back to WidgetBaseClass, the inferred parent recorded by the boot contract. A position is the first occurrence among names listed by the xivl-client-scripts N-API index, value namespaces included.
reach.precedingNative: MainMenuWidget, MapNavigationWidget, PlayerParameterWidget and StatusEffectWidget reach _setUICommandCondition at position 9, before the natives above. Its row is recorded here.

notFunctors._table: Value namespace. Its name literal 0x00FE0870 is referenced only from 0x0078FC90, which also registers _string.

rows.behavior: The callback is a thunk to 0x006F4C80 with the engine handle from ExecuteParameters +0x04, the argument list and the control identity from ExecuteParameters +0x0C. A non-Nil text identifier composes the literal @ from 0x00FD4DCC and the identifier, then each int appends /i from 0x00FD4DD4 and the value and each string appends /s from 0x00FD4DD0 and the string. A Nil identifier leaves the text empty. 0x006EAA20 then resolves the receiver identity through 0x0075BB60 and calls 0x0075BB80 five times on the list control named by argument 0, setting Index to argument 1, AttributeName to argument 2, ValueType to the static pickup at 0x0134B898, StringValue to the composed text and Action to the static pickup at 0x0134B8F0.

rows.behavior: Builds a condition through 0x007172A0 from argument 1, a kind byte stored at +0x54 and a value byte stored at +0x55. A Nil argument 2 uses kind byte 0x012C3F78, which holds 0x01 in the PE image, and value 0. An int argument 2 uses the kind byte at 0x0134C3FE, which lies in the zero-filled part of .data and has no direct writer reference, and the low byte of the value. Its run-time value was not traced. 0x0075B7B0 resolves the control identity from ExecuteParameters +0x0C through 0x004D9910 and passes argument 0 and the condition to 0x0053AB80.

returnObjects.source: 0x00707970 reads the engine handle at ExecuteParameters +0x04, whose +0x00 holds the GameEngine. 0x00CC7510 dereferences the handle and returns the address GameEngine +0x220. The callback reads the pointer stored at GameEngine +0x220, then the pointer at +0x04 of that object, then the LuaControl* at +0x0C of the second object, and passes it to 0x00748B30.
returnObjects.object: Through the luaControlPush lookup, the MyPlayer control's instance table when its pool holds one, otherwise the root record's entry in the pool named by the value at 0x0130D4F8. A null control pointer pushes nil. The call creates and caches nothing and does not yield.
returnObjects.scriptUse: The shipped DesktopWidget methods getPlayerGaugeMaxParameter and getPlayerGaugeCurrentParameter call getHPMax, getMPMax, getTPMax, getHP, getMP and getTP on the result. Those names resolve in the CharaBaseClass method table of chara/charabaseclass_parameter.

returnObjects.source: A number argument becomes an identity through 0x00CC70E0 and 0x00D03A50, which run on the object held at GameEngine +0x1C4 and add the number to the identity base of the static kind byte at 0x0130D426. A string argument is matched through 0x00CC7130 and 0x00D13310 against the 0x68-byte entries at +0xE4 of the object held at GameEngine +0x1C8 (count at +0xE8), comparing the name key with entry +0x5C and returning the identity at entry +0x00.
returnObjects.object: Pushed through 0x00748B30 and the luaControlPush lookup: the static control's instance table when its pool holds one, otherwise the root record's entry in the pool named by the value at 0x0130D4F8. When 0x00CC7A50 finds no control, 0x00CC7180 tests the identity against the list at +0x100 of the object held at GameEngine +0x1C8. Only when the identity is absent from that list, 0x00CC7160 reaches 0x00D037A0 on the object held at GameEngine +0x1C4, which increments the count at +0x0C of the identity's map entry unless its owner's +0x54 flag is clear and the identity is a registered static identity, and 0x00CC78C0 resolves the control through 0x00CDDE20 with its create flag clear. 0x00CDDE20 returns null when the class record's +0x7B byte is clear. The call yields through CreateStaticActorResumeChecker on three routes: the identity is already in the +0x100 list, 0x00CC78C0 returns null, or 0x00CC72A0 reports the +0x7D flag of the new control's object reference clear.
returnObjects.instanceName: 0x00CDDE20 formats the literal _static%X at 0x0110E8C0 with the low 20 bits of the identity when the class record it finds through 0x00CD8870 has byte +0x7B set.
returnObjects.corpusArguments: All 31 constant arguments in the shipped scripts are numbers. Seven call sites pass a computed value. WorldMaster._onInit passes the number 310001.

userConfig.storeContract: The store is the Application::Misc::GameConfig object with 7 groups. manifests/user_config_store.json records every registered group, key, name, range word and default, the per-character game file and its override order.
userConfig.store: The user config store is at +0x17430 of the object 0x0075CAB0 reaches through its receiver, as returned by 0x004D73C0. Its +0x04 holds the group count, +0x08 the record array and +0x0C a dirty flag.
userConfig.addressing: 0x00443EA0 addresses record (group * 32 + (key & 0x1F)) * 0xBC from +0x08. The group is not range-checked and the key wraps every 32 values.

userConfig.corpusKeys: Of the 11 shipped call sites, four in DesktopWidget methods of widget/desktopwidget_connector pass group 6 with a key computed from a log index. widget/logwidget and widget/logcolorsettingwidget each pass group 2 with a computed key. The remaining five are DesktopWidget wrapper methods that pass both values from their caller.
userConfig.siblings: 0x0075C9C0 resets one value. A type 1 record takes its default through 0x00443DA0 and a type 2 record takes the empty string at 0x00FD866A through 0x00443E00. It is called from 0x006E5625 inside the _resetUserConfig callback.

boundaries: _getMyPlayer and _getStaticActor keep their call contracts in manifests/boot_native_call_contract.json. This manifest adds the object their LuaControl* return pushes.
The Lua class of the MyPlayer control and the site that registers its instance table were not traced. Script use shows CharaBaseClass methods on it.
The class selection and instance construction inside 0x00CDDE20 were not traced beyond the _static%X name and the 0x00CD8870 class lookup.
The kind byte at 0x0134C3FE is in uninitialized data and its run-time value was not traced. The meaning of the condition kinds and of 0x0053AA00 and 0x0053AB80 was not traced.
The static pickups at 0x0134B898 and 0x0134B8F0 are initialized at run time. manifests/user_config_store.json records the user config groups, keys, names and defaults.

Deferred rows carry registration and declared lists only. Their handlers and forwarding targets were not recorded here. manifests/stub_overload_native_call_contract.json records them for _setListProperty and _updateList, and manifests/user_config_store.json records the forwarding targets of _setUserConfig, _saveUserConfig and _resetUserConfig.
The DesktopWidget reach paths rely on WidgetBaseClass as its inferred parent, as in the boot contract.
Reach positions are static call-site order across every branch. They do not establish which calls run at runtime.
These are client marshalling contracts. They do not establish user config content, widget layout, or server behavior.
